lines.text: Alex hiked up to Scout Lookout, ready for Angels Landing.
Then a ranger asked for his permit. He didn't have one.
The climb from Scout Lookout to the summit needs a permit, all year.
Here's the fix. Apply on recreation dot gov: the seasonal lottery, or the day-before lottery, which closes at 3 pm.

lines.text: No luck? Scout Lookout needs no permit, and the view is huge.
Next morning, Alex had his permit.
Save this before your Zion trip.
